1.body: A scammer can sound exactly like your son. They can't unlock his phone.

howItWorks.step4_you: Your phone checks the signed answer
howItWorks.voiceTitle: Why a copied voice can't pass
howItWorks.voiceBody: The check never listens to the voice. Only the key inside {{person}}'s phone can answer, and only after they unlock it with their fingerprint or PIN.
howItWorks.serverTitle: What our server can and can't do
howItWorks.serverBody2: It can't create or change a signed answer.
howItWorks.serverBody3: If it fails, you see “Not confirmed yet”, never green.
howItWorks.voiceBody_you: The check never listens to the voice. Only the key inside your phone can answer, and only after you unlock it with your fingerprint or PIN.

limits.title: What Pehchaan can't protect against
limits.card1Body: A PIN is a key too. Keep it private, even within the family.
limits.card2: Harmful apps already on your phone
limits.card2Body: Only install apps from the Play Store or App Store, and never because a caller asked.
limits.card3: A family member being forced to say yes
limits.card3Body: If something feels wrong even after green, call them back on their usual number.
limits.card4: People who aren't in your family list
limits.card4Body: Pehchaan can only check people you added in person.
limits.closing: Pehchaan confirms who answered. It can't tell whether they're safe. In an emergency, call 112.

suspicious.step3: Never share an OTP or install an app a caller asks for.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Exactly what Pehchaan keeps, where, and for how long.

phone.family: Your name, phone number, family list, labels and safety words. Kept until you delete them.
phone.history: Your checks, answers, results and alerts. Kept until you delete them.

server.device: This phone's random ID, public key, phone type, app version and the day it was last seen. Used to deliver messages and stop abuse. Kept until you delete your data, or after 12 months without use.
server.contacts: Which phones may contact yours, and a fingerprint of your code (never the code itself). Kept until you remove them or delete your data.
server.push: Your notification address, used to wake the app. Kept until it expires or you delete your data.
server.envelopes: Sealed messages waiting to be delivered. The server can't read them. Kept from 60 seconds to 24 hours.
server.ip: Your internet address, scrambled, to limit abuse. Kept up to an hour.
server.security: Security events, with no names and no message contents. Kept 1 year.
server.errors: Error reports with personal details removed. Kept 30 days.

privacy.neverServer: The server never stores names, phone numbers, amounts, labels or what you answered.
privacy.rights: Delete all data (in Settings) removes everything on this phone and asks the server to forget this phone within 24 hours. Removing a family member stops their phone reaching yours.
privacy.processors: Service providers: Oracle Cloud in Mumbai runs the server. Error reports, monitoring and encrypted backups may be kept by providers outside India.
privacy.guard: Call Guard runs on a laptop. Its audio and transcript stay in that browser, though the browser's own speech service may process the audio. Use it only with the consent of the person whose call it is.
